scope: Independent review of actual source, metadata qualification, pinned original-source proof, source-index bytes, exact-package examples and ancillary statements; correlated with completed main ARM builds and seven finite source/data commands. Main acceptance only.

required_checks: one GLOBAL route and exact vector name

manual_facts: TXE is buffer availability rather than wire completion
DR reads consume RXNE; no wanted receive data is cleared first
BUSY must clear before CS release; no BUSY interrupt enable exists
IER bits 0..7, read-only ISR bits 0..8 and R1W0 ICR bits 0..7
FLUSH zero clears the TX buffer and shifter destructively
enable location CR1.6 or native CR2.0; zero disables
MODF clears EN, retains its sticky flag and permits transfer on re-enable
original_source_review.w031_own_datasheet_exclusion: External SPI unavailable while internal RF is used; no new RF ownership or continuity claim

complete_stage88_to_main_delta.boundary: Complete main source delta before later pure administrative acceptance/status/package inclusion changes; any later export needs its own freeze and clean replay.

examples.l010_route: PA5 SCK, PA6 MOSI, PA3 MISO AF3; PA4 GPIO CS
examples.l012_bindings: SPI1 dedicated; full SPI23 handler with both SPI2/SPI3 owners retained and exercised
examples.application_calls: All five real byte async SpiBus methods, unequal transfer and empty calls; separate blocking u16 operation
examples.chip_select: Only raised after the full sequence succeeds; errors park without completion/retry claims
examples.lock_root_change: Rename and direct edge to already locked embedded-hal 1.0.0 only

diagnostics.qualification: Existing unused generated RCC LSE constants; no SPI diagnostic and no source change made to hide warnings.

acquired_source_scope.note: Optional discovery pages are not hardware originals and are not claimed as acquired.

clean_replay.requirement: Separate final exported-source replay; this main review does not claim that clean already ran.

limitations: Hardware, electrical behavior, IRQ latency, throughput, RF coexistence, low-power behavior and finite liveness are not validated.
No firmware was flashed or run. Static ELF RAM ranges are linked allocations, not a stack high-water measurement.
Source/metadata review does not replace the separate actual runtime lifecycle review.
This reviewer performed read-only source/artifact inspection and wrote review artifacts only; it ran no Cargo, generation, source gate, HAL test, probe or host model.
